scripts.build: tsc --noEmit -p tsconfig.json && npm run build:css && npm run build:js && node -e "const fs=require('fs'); const path=require('path'); const copy=(src,dst)=>{const stat=fs.statSync(src); if(stat.isDirectory()){fs.mkdirSync(dst,{recursive:true}); for(const entry of fs.readdirSync(src)){copy(path.join(src,entry),path.join(dst,entry));} return;} fs.mkdirSync(path.dirname(dst),{recursive:true}); fs.copyFileSync(src,dst);}; copy('public','dist');" && node scripts/runtime-config.mjs
scripts.test:unit: tsc -p tsconfig.unit.json && node --experimental-specifier-resolution=node dist-unit/unit/auth-session.unit.test.js && node --experimental-specifier-resolution=node dist-unit/unit/use-auth-backend.unit.test.js && node --experimental-specifier-resolution=node dist-unit/unit/app-domain.unit.test.js && node --experimental-specifier-resolution=node dist-unit/unit/visa-domain.unit.test.js && node --experimental-specifier-resolution=node dist-unit/unit/app-route.unit.test.js
